title: Gingerbread Army and Blue Oracle
description: A line of identical women with long green braided hair and red bows walks across a cosmic plane, holding hands. Below them, a large group of gingerbread men cookies with purple icing and candy details are entangled by purple tentacles on a dark starry surface, while a glowing blue creature with large eyes peeks from the right edge holding a cookie.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene showing a procession of identical women with long green braided hair tied with red bows, wearing dark robes, walking hand in hand from left to right across a starry plane. In the foreground, numerous gingerbread cookies decorated with purple icing and candy are entangled by thick purple tentacles on a dark textured surface. On the right, a glowing blue round creature with big sparkling eyes and a yellow aura peeks over the edge while holding a small gingerbread man. The background features abstract mystical symbols in light tones, colorful glowing orbs floating in space, rendered in a detailed illustrative painting style.
